slides.title: The KFFM joins your weekly leadership meeting.
slides.headline: The KFFM joins your weekly leadership meeting.
slides.support: Put the KFFM on the weekly agenda in Metronome.
body: Each owner reports their critical number: green, yellow or red.
A red number comes with a written plan: situation, cause, correction, follow-up.
notes: The KFFM is in Metronome with its metrics, from last quarter’s homework.
The weekly meeting reviews the numbers. It does not redraw the map. The map changes at the quarterly.
Homework: review the KFFM in every weekly leadership meeting.
